stories.title: Configure GKE Horizontal Pod Autoscaler for offer services
stories.user_story: As a platform operator, I want GKE Horizontal Pod Autoscalers configured with appropriate min/max pod counts and CPU/memory thresholds for all offer microservices, so that the platform scales automatically under load without manual intervention.
acceptance_criteria: HPA configured for each offer microservice with min 3 / max 20 pods
Scale-up triggered at 70% CPU or 80% memory utilisation
Scale-down cooldown set to 5 minutes to prevent flapping
Pre-scaling CronJobs configured for known peak periods (lunchtime 11:30-13:30, evening 17:00-19:00)
Load test confirms scale-up from 3 to 12 pods within 90 seconds under 10x traffic spike

stories.title: Implement Cloud Monitoring dashboards and PagerDuty alerting
stories.user_story: As a platform operator, I want unified Cloud Monitoring dashboards with SLA tracking and PagerDuty integration, so that I have real-time visibility into platform health and receive immediate alerts when SLOs are breached.
acceptance_criteria: SLA dashboard displays p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, and availability for each service
Alerts fire to PagerDuty when error rate exceeds 1% or p99 latency exceeds 500ms for 5 minutes
Cloud Trace enabled with 10% sampling rate across all services for distributed tracing
Structured logging via Cloud Logging with correlation IDs propagated across service boundaries
Dashboard accessible to on-call engineers with no additional auth beyond Lloyds SSO

stories.title: Deploy multi-zone GKE cluster with Cloud SQL high availability
stories.user_story: As a platform operator, I want the GKE cluster deployed across multiple zones with Cloud SQL regional HA, so that a single zone failure does not cause service disruption.
acceptance_criteria: GKE node pools span at least 3 zones within europe-west2 (London)
Cloud SQL configured with regional HA (automatic failover to standby in different zone)
Pod anti-affinity rules ensure replicas are distributed across zones
Simulated zone failure demonstrates zero-downtime failover within 30 seconds
Terraform IaC defines all multi-zone configuration

stories.title: Implement circuit breakers and graceful degradation
stories.user_story: As a platform operator, I want circuit breakers on all external service calls and graceful degradation paths, so that downstream failures do not cascade and users still receive a reduced-functionality experience.
acceptance_criteria: Circuit breakers configured via Cloud Service Mesh (Istio) for all external dependencies
Circuit opens after 5 consecutive failures or 50% error rate in a 30-second window
Graceful degradation returns cached offers when the personalisation engine is unavailable
Health check endpoints report degraded state (HTTP 200 with degraded flag) rather than failing
Runbook documents each degradation path and expected user impact

stories.title: Configure Cloud Armor WAF with rate limiting and abuse prevention
stories.user_story: As a platform operator, I want Cloud Armor policies enforcing rate limits, bot detection, and location spoofing prevention, so that the platform is protected from abuse and fraudulent redemptions.
acceptance_criteria: Cloud Armor rate limiting set to 100 requests/minute per authenticated user
Bot detection rules block known automated user agents and headless browsers
Location spoofing detection flags requests where GPS coordinates conflict with IP geolocation by >50km
Redemption fraud rules limit offer redemptions to 1 per user per offer per 24-hour window
Blocked requests return HTTP 429 with appropriate Retry-After header

stories.title: Implement Redis caching layer and CDN for offer content
stories.user_story: As a platform operator, I want Memorystore (Redis) caching for hot offer data and Cloud CDN for static offer assets, so that read-heavy workloads are served with sub-50ms latency without hitting the database.
acceptance_criteria: Memorystore Redis cluster deployed with 2 read replicas in europe-west2
Offer catalogue cached with 5-minute TTL; cache-aside pattern implemented
Cloud CDN configured for offer images and merchant logos with 24-hour cache
Cache hit ratio exceeds 85% for offer listing endpoints under steady-state traffic
Cloud SQL read replicas serve analytics and reporting queries to offload primary

stories.title: Create spatial indexes for location-based offer queries
stories.user_story: As a platform operator, I want PostGIS spatial indexes on offer location data, so that nearby-offer queries execute within 20ms even at scale.
acceptance_criteria: PostGIS extension enabled on Cloud SQL PostgreSQL instance
GiST spatial index created on merchant location geometry column
Nearby-offer query (radius search) returns results in <20ms for 100k merchant locations
Query plan confirms index usage via EXPLAIN ANALYZE
Index maintenance automated via scheduled REINDEX during low-traffic window

stories.title: Establish DR testing and chaos engineering programme
stories.user_story: As a platform operator, I want automated DR test scripts and a monthly chaos engineering schedule, so that we continuously validate platform resilience and reduce mean time to recovery.
acceptance_criteria: DR test runbook covers full regional failover to europe-west1 (Belgium) backup
Quarterly DR test executes end-to-end failover and validates RTO <15 minutes, RPO <5 minutes
Monthly chaos experiments include: random pod termination, zone failure simulation, network partition injection
Chaos experiments run in a dedicated chaos namespace with blast radius controls
Post-incident reports generated automatically with findings and remediation actions
All chaos tooling (e.g., Litmus/Chaos Mesh) deployed via Terraform
